name: #FauxFilter Luminous Matte Liquid Foundation
shortDescription: Cult-favorite full-coverage foundation with a transfer-proof, luminous matte finish.
description: Huda Beauty #FauxFilter Luminous Matte Foundation delivers instant full coverage with a weightless, non-drying texture. Formulated to blur pores, conceal imperfections, and provide a seamless filter-like finish that resists humidity and shine throughout the day.

name: Power Bullet Matte Lipstick - Interview (Warm Peachy Nude)
shortDescription: Ultra-pigmented velvet matte lipstick with comfortable, non-drying plush wear.
description: The Power Bullet Matte Lipstick delivers unparalleled color payoff with a velvety, cushiony finish. Custom-shaped with a diamond-faceted bullet for surgical precision application without needing a separate lip liner.

name: Power Bullet Matte Lipstick - Board Meeting (Warm Cinnamon Mocha)
shortDescription: Rich cinnamon-mocha warm nude lipstick with flawless matte longevity.
description: Board Meeting is a warm spiced mocha that adds power and dimension to any beauty look. The formula coats lips in a plush, comfortable layer that resists feathering and fading.

name: Power Bullet Matte Lipstick - Ladies Night (Bold Burgundy Berry)
shortDescription: Sensual bold berry wine lipstick designed for evening glamour.
description: Ladies Night commands attention with its deep, dramatic wine-red depth. Glides effortlessly across lips with intense chromatic impact and long-wearing satin-matte comfort.

name: Power Bullet Matte Lipstick - Third Date (Rosewood Mauve)
shortDescription: Flattering rosewood pink shade offering effortless everyday sophistication.
description: Third Date is the romantic rosewood nude shade you'll reach for daily. Perfectly balanced undertones complement neutral, warm, and cool complexions seamlessly.

name: Power Bullet Matte Lipstick - Rendez-Vous (Dusty Pink Coral)
shortDescription: Youthful dusty coral-pink matte lipstick with instant brightening effect.
description: A soft, romantic blush-coral that instantly refreshes your complexion. Formulated with saturated pigments for full coverage in a single gentle glide.

name: Power Bullet Matte Lipstick - Prom Night (Luxe Rosy Coral)
shortDescription: Elegant, lively pink-coral lipstick for special occasions and celebrations.
description: Prom Night is a radiant, celebratory rose hue with soft coral undertones. Delivers an ultra-creamy application that dries down to a powdery velvet matte touch.

name: Power Bullet Matte Lipstick - El Cinco De Mayo (Fiery Scarlet Red)
shortDescription: Showstopping warm scarlet red lipstick with breathtaking pigment intensity.
description: The quintessential power red. El Cinco De Mayo delivers an explosive pop of color that elevates any makeup look. Transfer-resistant with a clean, razor-sharp edge.

name: Habibti Lip Contour & Liquid Matte Lip Duo Set
shortDescription: Exclusive 2-piece set containing full-size lip contour pencil and long-wear liquid matte lipstick.
description: Curated to create the signature Huda pout. Features a glide-on lip contour liner pencil to sculpt and define, paired with a lightweight, comfortable liquid matte lipstick that stays vibrant for hours.

specifications.Contents: 1x Lip Contour Pencil + 1x Liquid Matte Lipstick

name: Silk Balm Hydrating Plumping Lip Gloss
shortDescription: Infused with hyaluronic filling spheres for high-shine hydration and subtle plumping.
description: A comfortable, non-sticky liquid balm gloss packed with soothing botanical actives, soybean extract, and licorice. Glides on to cushion lips in glassy shine and instant moisture.

name: Next Level Formula Powder Blush - Orgasm
shortDescription: The globally acclaimed peachy-pink blush with fine golden shimmer.
description: NARS' legendary blush formula provides a natural, healthy-looking flush of color that enlivens any complexion. Micronized powder pigments guarantee soft, blendable application with iconic gold reflex.

name: Contour, Highlight & Cheek Sculpting Palette Kit
shortDescription: Multi-dimensional cheek palette featuring contour powders, luminous bronzer, and radiant blush.
description: Designed for effortless face sculpting. Includes NARS' cult-favorite Laguna bronzer, warm highlighting powders, and sculpting tones that chisel cheekbones and impart a sun-kissed warmth.

name: Afterglow Lip Shine Hydrating Mirror Lip Gloss
shortDescription: Comfortable high-shine lip gloss enriched with pomegranate flower extract and jojoba oil.
description: Drench lips in glossy, mirror-like color and eight hours of continuous hydration. Features a custom applicator that distributes optimal pigment for a pillowy, reflective pout.

name: Studio Fix Powder Plus Foundation - Velvet Matte
shortDescription: A one-step powder and foundation that gives skin a smooth, ultra-matte finish with medium-to-full coverage.
description: MAC's iconic compact powder controls shine and oil for 12 hours while creating a velvety, poreless complexion. Breathable, non-caking, and resistant to sweat and humidity.

name: Strobe Cream Hydratant Lumineux Illuminating Primer
shortDescription: The ultimate quick fix for skin, boosting tired skin with iridescent particles and vitamins.
description: Powered by potent botanicals, green tea, and iridescent pearl particles, MAC Strobe Cream enhances the effects of light on all skin tones, creating a dewy, candlelit glow under makeup or worn alone.

name: Double Extension Beauty Tubes 2-in-1 Lengthening Mascara
shortDescription: Two-step conditioning base coat and carbon-black tubing mascara for ultra-extended lashes.
description: Step 1 conditions lashes with Ceramide R and Provitamin B5. Step 2 wraps lashes in smudge-proof tubes that visibly lengthen lashes up to 80% without flaking, running, or clumping.

name: Infallible Full Wear Waterproof Concealer (24H Coverage)
shortDescription: Ultra-pigmented full-coverage concealer with extra-large applicator wand.
description: Conceals dark circles, blemishes, and discoloration in a single swipe. The waterproof, non-greasy formula does not crease, cake, or settle into fine lines for up to 24 hours.

name: Flawless Finish Matte Liquid Foundation
shortDescription: Lightweight liquid foundation that blends seamlessly into skin for a satin-matte semi-matte finish.
description: Enriched with glycerin to hydrate and soften skin. Improves uneven skin tone and texture, giving an oil-free, all-day semi-matte look that feels weightless on the skin.

name: Professional Face & Eye Makeup Brush Set (Complete Kit)
shortDescription: Expert collection of super-soft synthetic bristles for flawless blending and powder application.
description: Features precision brushes for foundation, contouring, blush, eyeshadow shading, crease blending, and eyeliner. 100% cruelty-free synthetic bristles that pick up optimal product without absorbing excess liquid.

specifications.Included Brushes: Powder Brush, Blush Brush, Angled Foundation, Eye Shader, Crease Blender

name: Sam & Nic Ultimate Base Precision Makeup Brush Set
shortDescription: Professional base brush kit crafted for streak-free foundation, concealer, and contouring.
description: Engineered by celebrity makeup artists Sam & Nic Chapman. Custom-cut bristle heads deliver seamless foundation buffing, detailed spot concealing, and effortless cheek sculpting.

name: Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toning Solution
shortDescription: Targeted direct acid toner that visibly boosts skin radiance and refines uneven texture.
description: A water-based toner formulated with 7% glycolic acid (an alpha hydroxy acid) and Tasmanian pepperberry derivative to help reduce irritation associated with acid use. Daily application helps smooth skin clarity and texture over time.

specifications.Key Botanicals: Tasmanian Pepperberry, Aloe Vera, Ginseng Root

name: Heartleaf 77% Clear Pad (Calming & Exfoliating Toner Pads)
shortDescription: Korea's viral calming toner pad soaked in 77% Houttuynia Cordata extract to soothe redness.
description: A dual-sided toner pad featuring embossed and smooth surfaces. Formulated with 77% Heartleaf extract harvested in Korea to calm sensitive skin, regulate excess sebum production, and tighten visible pores without stripping moisture.

name: Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Intensive Ampoule
shortDescription: Fermented Madagascar Centella and vegan ceramides to deeply repair compromised skin barriers.
description: This rich, milky ampoule combines fermented Centella Asiatica with TECA (Titrated Extract of Centella Asiatica) and skin-identical ceramides. Dramatically strengthens weakened skin barriers, calms sensitivity, and restores supple elasticity.

specifications.Key Actives: Fermented Madagascar Centella, Ceramide NP, TECA

name: Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Relief Ampoule (Acne Care)
shortDescription: Instant soothing ampoule infused with Tea Tree Leaf Water and Centella for irritated and blemish-prone skin.
description: Formulated with Pine Tree Complex and Centella Asiatica to quickly relieve inflamed breakouts and rebalance moisture. Light, non-comedogenic liquid texture absorbs instantly without oily residue.

specifications.Key Actives: Tea Tree Leaf Water, Centella Asiatica, Pine Tree Extract

name: Nourishing Oil-to-Foam Cleanser with Prebiotics & Aloe
shortDescription: Transforms from a rich oil to gentle foam to dissolve makeup and grime without stripping natural moisture.
description: Formulated for dry to normal, sensitive skin. Enriched with soothing aloe vera, nourishing prebiotics, and essential vitamins B3 and provitamin B5 to preserve the skin's natural microbiome and moisture balance.

specifications.Key Actives: Aloe Vera, Prebiotic complex, Vitamin B3 & B5

name: Hydro Boost 3-in-1 Micellar Cleansing Water (400ml)
shortDescription: Gently removes stubborn waterproof makeup, cleanses dirt, and quenches thirsty skin with Hyaluronic Acid.
description: Powered by triple micellar technology and hyaluronic acid. Leaves skin feeling remarkably clean, refreshed, and soft without any stinging or oily film.

name: Hydro Boost Hydrating Hydrogel Face Sheet Mask Sachet
shortDescription: 100% hydrogel mask contours to face and delivers equivalent of 1 bottle of serum in 15 minutes.
description: An intensive hydrating treatment that holds up to 50% more essence than standard paper sheet masks. Cools on contact and infuses skin with moisture-binding hyaluronic acid.

name: Lait-Crème Concentré Multi-Function Cream & Makeup Base
shortDescription: Legendary 6-in-1 French pharmacy moisturizer, makeup primer, moisturizing mask, and cleanser milk.
description: Celebrated by makeup artists worldwide. Formulated with shea butter, beeswax, soy proteins, and aloe vera. Restores suppleness, primes skin perfectly for seamless foundation adherence, and relieves dry patches.

specifications.Key Actives: Shea Butter, Beeswax, Soy Protein, Aloe

name: Hydrating Milky Peel Gentle Smoothing Face Polish
shortDescription: Micro-peeling cream that gently lifts away dead surface skin cells and impurities for baby-soft skin.
description: Infused with coconut, arginine, and cellulose to gently polish away dull skin without abrasive scratching. Soothes delicate skin while revealing a brighter, clearer, refined complexion.

name: On-The-Glow Tinted Moisture Stick Blush & Lip Tint
shortDescription: Convenient twist-up solid tint enriched with ginseng, aloe vera, and fruit extracts for juicy cheek color.
description: Swipe on radiant color in seconds. This hydrating cheek and lip tint delivers sheer, buildable dewiness that blends effortlessly with fingertips. Formulated without parabens and never tested on animals.

name: Ultimate Shadow Palette - 16 Warm Neutrals
shortDescription: Pro-level 16-shade eyeshadow palette packed with warm terracottas, satins, shimmers, and velvety mattes.
description: A pro-curated collection of warm amber, bronze, burnt copper, and matte chocolate shades. Highly blendable with minimal fallout, delivering rich color saturation for subtle daytime or dramatic smoky night looks.

name: Matte & Dewy Finish 2-Piece Makeup Setting Spray Kit
shortDescription: Weightless setting mist duo that locks makeup in place with zero shine and all-day wear.
description: The gold standard of drug-store and pro setting sprays. Prevents color fading, makeup melt, and creasing throughout humid conditions while providing a fresh, comfortable hold.

name: Make-up Cover Legendary High Coverage Waterproof Foundation
shortDescription: Clinically tested extreme coverage foundation covering 100% of tattoos, spots, and discoloration.
description: Originally created in Barrandov Film Studios in Prague, Dermacol Make-up Cover contains over 50% pigment. A tiny pin-drop is sufficient to cover extreme blemishes, dark spots, acne scars, and tattoos with a waterproof, velvety film.

name: Naked Cherry 12-Pan Ultra-Rich Eyeshadow Palette
shortDescription: 12 sultry cherry hues ranging from soft blush ivory to deep metallic black cherry.
description: A decadent spectrum of berry and cherry shades formulated with Urban Decay's proprietary Pigment Infusion System for velvety texture, rich color payoff, and seamless blendability. Includes full-size double-ended eyeshadow brush.

name: Carli Bybel Limited Edition Eyeshadow & Pressed Pigment Palette
shortDescription: 14 versatile shades featuring frosted metallics, warm taupes, and shimmering amethyst tones.
description: Created in collaboration with iconic beauty influencer Carli Bybel. Features a curated mix of warm neutrals, duo-chromes, and soft berry pigments that transition seamlessly from daytime elegance to glamorous evening drama.

name: Tamanna 'Dress Your Face' Signature Eyeshadow Palette
shortDescription: World-famous collaboration palette engineered specifically for bridal, festive, and glam artistry.
description: Curated by master makeup artist Tamanna Roashan. Rich jewel tones, deep chocolate transition shades, and shimmering gold pressed pigments designed to flatter warm and olive undertones.

name: Morphe x Avani Gregg For the Bebs Artistry Palette
shortDescription: 30 vibrant shades featuring bold pastels, electric neons, and everyday essential mattes.
description: Dive into unlimited creative possibilities with 30 playful, high-energy shades. Soft-focus pastels meet striking jewel metallics and rich transition neutrals.

name: Tartelette Amazonian Clay Matte 12-Pan Eyeshadow Palette
shortDescription: 12 universally flattering all-matte eyeshadows arranged in coordinated rows for effortless looks.
description: Infused with nutrient-rich Amazonian clay for better, longer, truer wear. Mineral pigments soothe and soften lids without creasing or fading throughout the day.

name: Re-Loaded Velvet Rose 15-Shade Eyeshadow Palette
shortDescription: 15 warm neutral, rose gold, and deep chocolate shades with supreme pigmentation.
description: A bestselling beauty icon. Features velvety matte transition shades alongside dazzling foiled shimmers. Blends like butter across lids for romantic day or smokey evening beauty.

name: Revolution Pro Brighter Than My Future Contour & Blush Palette
shortDescription: All-in-one face palette containing silky contour powders, soft blushes, and beam highlighters.
description: Everything you need to sculpt, define, and illuminate in one sleek palette. The finely milled powders melt into skin for an airbrushed, lit-from-within glow.

name: Rouge Dior Couture Long-Wear Floral Lip Care Lipstick
shortDescription: The iconic couture lipstick enriched with red peony and pomegranate flower extract for 16 hours of comfort.
description: True luxury for your lips. Rouge Dior dresses the smile in iconic shades while delivering clean floral lip care. The refined houndstooth bullet delivers rich color with sublime satin comfort.

name: Major Volume High-Shine Plumping Lip Gloss
shortDescription: High-shine plumping gloss formulated with warm active cinnamon and peptides for instantly fuller lips.
description: Gives your lips an instant high-gloss lacquer finish with maximum plumping volume. Non-sticky cushion texture cushions lips while optical pearls reflect light from every angle.

name: Jelly Wow Hydrating Lip Plumping Gloss & Oil
shortDescription: Ultra-cushiony jelly lip oil with fruit seed extracts for glossy, baby-smooth lips.
description: Combines the shine of a lip gloss with the deep hydration of a rich lip oil. Melts onto lips without stickiness, leaving behind an irresistible glassy sheen and subtle fruit scent.

name: Velvet Matte Moisture Lipstick Duo
shortDescription: Silky matte lipstick with nourishing botanical emollients and intense color payoff.
description: Glides seamlessly onto lips, providing rich pigmented color in a modern soft-focus matte finish. Keeps lips moisturized and protected all day.

name: Professional Smoky Lash 2-in-1 Volumizing Mascara
shortDescription: Ultra-pigmented pro formula that curls, lengthens, and volumizes in a single sweep.
description: Formulated for runway and high-definition photography. Dense bristled wand catches and coats every lash from root to tip in carbon black pigment for maximum volume without clumping.

name: Hold 'Em Up Tinted Brow Sculpting Gel & Micro Mascara
shortDescription: Precision micro-spoolie brow gel that lifts, sets, and tints brows for a laminated look.
description: Holds brows securely in place all day without stiff flaking. Micro-fibers cling to brow hairs to fill in sparse gaps and create full, fluffy, natural-looking brows.

name: Precision Micro Definer Waterproof Eyebrow Pencil Duo
shortDescription: Ultra-fine mechanical brow pencil that draws realistic, hair-like strokes with waterproof durability.
description: Features an ultra-slim 1.5mm tip for pinpoint hair-like precision. Dual-ended design includes a built-in blending spoolie to soften harsh lines for effortlessly groomed arches.

name: Glass Skin Full Coverage Hydrating Liquid Foundation
shortDescription: Ultra-luminous glass skin foundation that covers imperfections while maintaining a reflective glow.
description: Formulated with light-diffusing pearl complexes and nourishing botanicals. Gives full coverage that looks like real, radiant, healthy skin without feeling heavy or oily.

name: Nourishing Berry Hydrating Lip Sleeping Mask (20g)
shortDescription: Overnight leave-on lip mask enriched with wild berry extracts, Vitamin C, and coconut butter.
description: Melts onto lips overnight to dissolve dead skin cells and lock in deep moisture. Wake up to plump, ultra-soft, supple lips that stay conditioned throughout the day.

specifications.Key Actives: Wild Berry Complex, Coconut Butter, Vitamin C & E
specifications.Use: Overnight Mask or Daily Lip Treatment

name: Hairline Root Touch-Up & Volumizing Shadow Powder
shortDescription: Instant root concealment and hairline contouring powder with built-in puff and mirror.
description: Instantly conceals sparse hairlines, visible roots, and grey hairs with water-resistant micro-pigments. The soft puff applicator provides targeted coverage that blends seamlessly into natural hair.

name: Conditioning Botanical Soothing Essential Body Oil
shortDescription: Relaxing botanical herbal body oil enriched with natural plant extracts for intensive skin conditioning.
description: Formulated with plant-derived botanical extracts to moisturize rough patches, soothe muscle tension, and promote skin suppleness. Fast-absorbing, non-sticky herbal texture.

name: Radiance Brightening Pearl Infused Vitality Serum Capsules
shortDescription: Individual biodegradable serum pearls containing concentrated niacinamide, peptides, and botanical oils.
description: Each single-dose pearl preserves maximum ingredient potency until the moment of application. Delivers concentrated brightening actives to diminish dark spots and reveal radiant vitality.

name: Hydrating Antibacterial Hand Sanitizer Spray (Pocket Mist)
shortDescription: Gentle pocket sanitizer mist that kills 99.9% of bacteria while nourishing hands with aloe vera.
description: A chic, sleek pocket-sized mist that sanitizes hands without drying. Formulated with 75% pharmaceutical-grade ethyl alcohol and soothing humectants for clean, soft hands on the go.
